name: tokenos-token-launch-planner
description: Step-by-step plan to create and launch a token on Solana (Pump.fun) or Robinhood Chain — costs, preparation, checklist and the mistakes to avoid.
keywords: how to create a solana token
how to launch a token on solana
how to make a crypto token

interface.longDescription:
Tell it the token name, ticker, chain and goal and get a complete launch plan: network and platform costs in SOL or ETH, what to prepare (logo, socials, wallet), the launch steps, a pre-flight checklist, the mistakes that sink launches, and a link to the TokenOS launch documentation. Compare Pump.fun, pons on Robinhood Chain and plain SPL mints, or estimate the total launch cost.

Tools:
• plan_token_launch — Produce a step-by-step launch plan for a token: costs, preparation, launch steps, checklist, pitfalls and a link to the launch documentation.
• compare_launch_platforms — Compare Pump.fun (Solana), pons (Robinhood Chain) and a plain SPL mint: wallet, cost, bonding curve and graduation, speed, audience.
• token_launch_costs — Estimate the total cost to launch a token on Solana or Robinhood Chain, including an optional initial buy.

Targets questions like: “how to create a solana token”; “how to launch a token on solana”; “launch token on pump.fun”; “token launch checklist”; “token launch guide”; “pump.fun launch cost”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/token-launch-planner

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
capabilities: Compare Pump.fun and Robinhood Chain launches
defaultPrompt: How do I launch a token called Moon Cat ($MCAT) on Solana?
How much does it cost to launch a token on Pump.fun?
Should I launch my community token on Solana or Robinhood Chain?

positive.prompt: How do I launch a token called Moon Cat ($MCAT) on Solana?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a numbered launch plan with costs in SOL, preparation list, checklist, pitfalls, an issuer disclaimer and a link to the TokenOS launch documentation.

positive.prompt: How much does it cost to launch a token on Pump.fun with a 0.5 SOL initial buy?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the fixed cost estimate plus the optional initial buy and the total in SOL.

positive.prompt: Should I launch my community token on Solana or Robinhood Chain?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a comparison table (wallet, cost, curve, speed, audience) and a rule of thumb.

positive.prompt: Plan a utility token launch for my app on Robinhood Chain, ticker INF, name Infra
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a plan tailored to MetaMask / pons with an extra 'write the token note' step and ETH-denominated costs.

positive.prompt: Help me launch a token called Blue Fox
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant asks for a 2–10 character ticker (tool validation requires it) before producing the plan.

negative.description: Unsupported chain — Tool supports solana and robinhood only; the assistant explains and offers those.
negative.prompt: Launch my token on Ethereum mainnet

negative.description: Price promise — No tool call; the assistant refuses to promise outcomes.
negative.prompt: Guarantee my token will 10x after launch

negative.description: Unrelated finance — No tool call; out of scope.
negative.prompt: How do I buy Bitcoin on Coinbase?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Launch costs quoted are third-party network and platform fees paid from the user's own wallet on TokenOS.
